# Opening Upload Samples

These original project assets are for manual upload testing only:

- `music.ogg`: sample opening audio.
- `avatar.webp`: sample character image.
- `opening-character.png`: alternate sample character image.

They are not default media, are not served from the public directory, and are
not included in application packages. User uploads continue to be stored under
the configured data directory, separately from these repository fixtures.
